components.title: Implement and validate parse_duration
components.what: Write parse_duration(s: str) -> int using a strict regex (e.g. re.fullmatch on tokens like r'(\d+)([hms])' with optional whitespace between, anchored to consume the whole trimmed string) to extract parts. Reject: empty or whitespace-only input, any leftover unmatched characters, decimal numbers, a n
